title: a `neural_block` descriptor stamped beyond the max schema_version is rejected by the version gate before the neural-specific checks ever run
why: This checks the same schema_version ceiling as row04, but on a
`neural_block` descriptor. `schema_version` is a hard gate, not a
discriminant: a higher version means this build cannot safely interpret
the artifact at all, so this check fires first, before the pattern-specific
`neural_block` checks are ever reached, in both languages.
That ordering is the point of this fixture: the descriptor is otherwise a
perfectly well-formed `neural_block` golden, so there is no other rejecting
rule it could be hitting instead — this confirms the version check outranks
the neural-specific validation rather than merely producing the same result.
The manifest-bypassing plugin loader is exercised too, since its only
structural gate is the shared validator, which runs before its own
